Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against the 5-hydroxytryptamine receptor 2A (CHEMBL224). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary, and require an INNER JOIN to compound_structures to ensure SMILES are present. Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL224 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles, sorted by compound_chembl_id.
